When I first installed the filter, the water had no taste and was clear of floaties as one would expect. So, the filter did work when first installed, but it did not last long.

There are only three members of my household so I wouldn't say the filter was subjected to high use. It's not like we were filling up ice chests with the icemaker in the fridge either. We just use the water and ice dispenser for cold drinking water.

I am very happy with my purchase of this water filter. I was a little worried about buying a non OEM filter for my kenmore fridge out of fear that it wouldn't fit properly or have a weird taste. I did not have either of these problems. The filter snapped right in with no problem at all. The water in my area tastes highly of chlorine and this does a great job of reducing that taste and makes the water seem fresher. I did let a few gallons of water run though after installing it but the water seemed clear from the start. I did not notice any more water restriction than what there was with the official kenmore brand filter which is awesome. This brand also has a 60 day guarantee which made me feel more comfortable with giving it a shot. It states it meets NSF/ANSI 42 standards so that makes me happy and assures me of the quality. With these costing only a fraction of the cost of the kenmore brand I can buy 5 for every 1 that kenmore would cost. Not to mention the kenmore brand ones are always hard to find in stock anywhere local. Lasting 6 months is a big win as well. I will most definitely be back to purchase again in the future. I did purchase this product at a discount in exchange for my honest review.

I have found that this product is excellent for using in my LG Fridge. In order to capitalize on the health benefits of water, it is essential to draw from a clean source of water.
I used to only purchase bottled water but the cost was getting out of control. That’s when I discovered the LG Refresh Premium Fridge Filter.
Delivery was fast and easy. The product took less than 5 minutes to install.
When I realized that there are more than 2100 known drinking water contaminants that may be present in tap water, including several known poisons it made my decision to purchase this filter immediately.
I received my delivery within just 2 days of placing the order.
I have done research to find out that the only way to ensure pure, contaminant-free drinking water is through the use of a point-of-use filtration system.
I had no idea that several types of cancer can be attributed to the presence of toxic materials in drinking water. Again this made the decision to purchase this filter very easy.
Clean, healthy drinking water is essential to a child’s proper mental and physical development.
According to the EPA, lead in drinking water contributes to 480,000 cases of learning disorders in children each year in the United States alone.
It is especially important for pregnant women to drink pure water as lead in drinking water can cause severe birth defects.
I would highly encourage everyone to use a fridge filter just like this.

I bought this to replace our LG refrigerator water filter. We use filter # 5231JA2002A. The first time I tried installing it, I didn't get the filter attached in its housing correctly, but I didn't realize it, and woke up to a flooded fridge and a damaged wood kitchen floor. After mopping up, I tried reinstalling. This time I pushed the filter up into its housing much more firmly and it felt like it was installed correctly. (I pressed it upward until I felt a soft click into place, then rotated it into the lock position.) But the filter fell out of its housing again. I had a bowl under it this time so I didn't have a huge flood to dry up, but I was surprised the filter fell this second time. Then my husband installed it -- same process, and he also felt he had the thing in there correctly but it fell out again. I'm returning this. Either it flat-out doesn't fit correctly, or it's so difficult to install the right way that you can't tell if you've got a tight seal or if you're going to face a wet mess. Poor design and/or incorrect labeling for the filter item number.
